### selected other protocols over HTTP {.smaller}
 
*  Remote Procedure Calls (SOAP, gRPC, ...)
   *  turn function/method call + return into HTTP request + response
   *  another common way of exposing remote "API"
*  MPEG-DASH, HTTP Live Streaming
   *  divide stream into small segments, playlists of those
   *  possibly multiple versions (quality, audio track, captions, ...)
   *  client requests segments, reloads playlists to learn about new segments
*  DNS over HTTPS
